progress_update.summary: We researched the linked-workflows branch in the Restate server, identified all protocol changes (CreateLink/RemoveLink commands + completion notification), and designed the user-facing SDK API through iterative discussion. API decision is locked: run_linked() as a terminal-like entry on Request builder, unlink() on workflow client. We started planning the TDD approach and identified test surfaces (tests/service.rs, tests/ui/, test-services/). Were mid-planning when session ended — specifically answering how to handle the shared-core dependency for tests.
progress_update.goal: Add linked workflow support to the Rust SDK with TDD approach. Success: run_linked().send() and unlink() work on workflow clients, backed by CreateLinkCommand/RemoveLinkCommand protocol messages.
accomplished: Researched ../restate linked-workflows branch — identified all protocol changes (CreateLinkCommandMessage 0x0415, RemoveLinkCommandMessage 0x0422, CreateLinkCompletionNotificationMessage 0x8015)
Researched ../restate/docs — full design docs, RFCs, code reviews, implementation plans for linked workflows
Designed and decided user API: run_linked(req).send() on workflow clients, unlink() fire-and-forget, linked: bool flag on Request struct
Saved API decision to project memory (decision_linked_workflows_api.md)
Created linked-workflows branch from client-macro, wrote task_context.md with full research
Identified TDD test surfaces: tests/service.rs (compile), tests/ui/ (negative compile), test-services/ (integration)
progress_update.now: Mid-way through /spectre:plan workflow — completed research (Step 1), reached clarification (Step 2) about how to handle the shared-core 0.7.1 dependency which lacks sys_create_link/sys_remove_link. User asked where shared-core lives (which GitHub repo) before answering.
next_steps: Answer: find where restate-sdk-shared-core is sourced (crates.io? git dep? local path?) and determine if we can fork/extend it
Complete the planning workflow — write plan.md and tasks.md
Write red TDD tests: tests/service.rs (run_linked exists on workflow client), test-services/linked_workflow.rs (integration service)
Implement: Request.linked field, macro codegen for run_linked()/unlink(), ContextInternal.send() linked path
constraints: shared-core 0.7.1 doesn't have sys_create_link/sys_remove_link — need to figure out dependency strategy
No MockVM in codebase — tests are either compile-time or full integration with real Restate
decisions: API: run_linked(req) on workflow client returns Request with linked:bool=true, .send() emits both OneWayCallCommand + CreateLinkCommand
API: unlink() on workflow client, fire-and-forget, emits RemoveLinkCommand
API: .send() returns impl InvocationHandle regardless of linked flag — CreateLink completion handled internally
blockers: Need to determine shared-core dependency source to decide how to add new VM methods
open_questions: Where is restate-sdk-shared-core hosted? Can we add it as a local workspace member or path dependency?
Should TDD tests stub VM methods, fork shared-core locally, or test only macro/Request layer first?
risks: Server-side linked-workflows has known critical bugs (VO parent wrong InvocationId, cancel not propagating to linked children) — may affect integration testing
